controller.selector: For every current variable v compute p(v)=positive clause occurrences and n(v)=negative clause occurrences. Select lexicographic minimum (p(v)*n(v), p(v)+n(v), v).

finite_semantic_control: Exact brute-force SAT may cross-check this frozen <=13-variable instance only; it has zero algorithm authority.
primary_question: Does one fixed answer-blind structural selector reach an audited polynomial terminal on the sealed R38 fixpoint before the frozen resource caps?
secondary_question: What exact cost trajectory does this fixed selector incur? No finite trajectory may be extrapolated into a polynomial theorem.
success_criterion: The fixed controller reaches an audited polynomial terminal before caps while exact finite semantic control preserves the source SAT status.
open_criterion: The controller exhausts allowed eliminations or remains outside audited terminals without a resource-cap violation; return OPEN, not proof.
resource_criterion: Any cap hit returns RESOURCE_BOUND_HIT, not negative evidence about P vs NP.
